interpretation: Every raw graph output and every compared owned OCR result was exactly equal across all variants.
Tiny detector concat-only graph median was 5.1647 percent lower; combined was 3.9071 percent lower, with nonoverlapping observed ranges.
Medium sparse eight-CPU full OCR combined median was 6.7546 percent lower than baseline and 3.9111 percent lower than concat-only, with nonoverlapping observed ranges.
Tiny and Small full OCR and the two-request Medium mixed throughput comparison have overlapping ranges; no clear improvement established.
Medium full raw graph combined median was 3.9456 percent higher with nonoverlapping observed ranges; the graph probe runs the dense output head while OCR uses compact projection.
Retained activation capacities were unchanged in every measured case. No general arena-memory reduction is claimed.
Samples are fixed, with no unchanged-code retries or pooled versions. One process order per case and bounded warm-up limit causal and steady-state conclusions.
Full 36-cell performance qualification was not run.
